notes:
TCC Website 0.13.3: features share one copy of the Divi plumbing

From the code audit of 24 November 2026. Nothing visitors or editors see
changes; the same code now lives in one place in the main file:
- tcc_site_body_layouts() and tcc_site_use_body_layout(): find a Theme
  Builder body layout by the short code it holds, and show it. Used by
  sermon series pages, Trinity Talk and the search page (three copies).
- tcc_site_gen() and tcc_site_new_gen(): the "generation" number in
  remembered results (sermons, talk, search, upcoming, layouts; same
  option names as before). Speakers no longer bumps Sermons' number by
  hand.
- tcc_site_loop_source(): an automatic list for Divi loops (hidden post
  type, kept out of the sitemap and the Theme Builder, answered through
  posts_pre_query). Used by event feeds, sermon series, the sermon page
  and Trinity Talk (four copies); each keeps its own "which items".
- tcc_site_divi_drawing(): the looser editor check the sermon page and
  Trinity Talk had written twice.

About 525 lines fewer in the features, 225 more in the main file.

Tested: new tests/playground/tests/shared-helpers.php; all 153 tests
pass in WordPress Playground. On staging (installed from this exact
code): pages signed out at 375, 768 and 1920; the Divi editor's loop
previews for events, sermons and Trinity Talk; paging of the every-date
events list. Not tested: a real phone, Safari, Firefox.
